semantic_correction.operator: PSN temporal affine transform followed by an ATLIF threshold surrogate
semantic_correction.dense_forward_equation: h[t,n] = bias[t] - center[t] + sum_s W[t,s] * x[s,n]
semantic_correction.implementation: flatten x_seq after the leading temporal dimension, then torch.addmm(bias, weight, flattened)
semantic_correction.forbidden_description: do not describe this implementation as a recurrent LIF state updated once per timestep

definitions.issue_order: pi is a fixed permutation of source-time indices
definitions.partial: P[t,k] = beta[t] + sum_{j<k} W[t,pi[j]] * x[pi[j]], beta=bias-center
definitions.per_source_contract: x[s] is guaranteed to be in the closed integer interval [ell[s], u[s]]

official_binary_positive_threshold.equality_reason: the model emits an event at h == Theta

asymmetric_ternary.equality_reason: both positive and negative threshold tests are inclusive in the model

binary_nonnegative_source.datapath: a static pre-scaled weight permits a conditional add and can remove the runtime multiplier

symmetric_ternary_source.datapath: a static pre-scaled magnitude permits add/subtract/skip and can remove the runtime multiplier

general_signed_integer_source.datapath: the issued prefix still needs signed multiplication; only the unissued suffix MACs are removed
general_signed_integer_source.actual_h67_relevance: the observed T10 ATLIF inputs are broad signed analog/quantized values, so binary ATLIF output does not imply multiplier-free ATLIF input

must_freeze: input, weight, bias, center and threshold integer widths and scales
zero points, rounding and saturation/overflow behavior
per-source legal input intervals and fail-closed handling of any out-of-range code
issue order per context and proof that every reordered prefix fits the accumulator
whether exactness targets the quantized integer reference or the floating PyTorch addmm reference
required_exact_hardware_contract.float_warning: bit-exact early resolution against PyTorch float addmm would require conservative outward-rounded interval arithmetic and the same reduction semantics; the practical hardware contract is an integer reference plus a separately admitted accuracy bridge

current_integer_bridge_warning.meaning: integer RTL equivalence does not establish deployment accuracy

dense_t10_reference_config.source: M265: 100 signed-INT8 weights, ten signed-Q24 biases and one Q24 threshold

symmetric_range_compression.condition: enforce x in [-A,+A], for example forbid the INT8 -128 code under a [-127,+127] contract
symmetric_range_compression.metadata: one remaining magnitude M[t,k] replaces Rmin/Rmax because the interval is [-M,+M]
symmetric_range_compression.risk: the exclusion or saturation of -128 must be checked over representative S10 and the paired accuracy path

incremental_alternative.state: one or two remaining-bound registers per output time instead of a full suffix lookup table
incremental_alternative.update: subtract the precomputed per-column extrema after each issued source time
incremental_alternative.t10_parallel_cost: ten bound-register updates per source issue plus binary two-sided threshold logic; ternary needs positive, negative and middle-region resolution logic
incremental_alternative.benefit: avoids consuming future x or products merely to prove they can be skipped
incremental_alternative.unadmitted: area, timing and energy are not synthesized in M360

bound_metadata_and_control_cost.cycle_realization_requirement: a per-lane resolution only saves arithmetic energy unless the unresolved-lane mask is compacted across tiles or every lane sharing an issue cycle is resolved; tile-wide stop is the conservative existing-array cycle metric

curated_integer_vector_recompute.scope: sample-0 curated ordinary, near-threshold and max-amplitude DP-TME vectors; not an S10 opportunity distribution

perfect_lane_compaction_upper_bound_from.reason: the source set is curated sample 0 and the current array obtained zero tile-wide skipped cycles

curated_integer_vector_recompute.interpretation: the proof is correct, but the only local vectors currently capable of replay show weak term savings and no conservative tile-cycle saving; this is negative predesign evidence, not a representative kill by itself

ordered_s10_trace.coverage: 79 operator rows, 1840 execution rows and 93 runtime ATLIF rows

curated_dptme_vectors.coverage: 81 live sites, 320 selected events per site, 25920 events, sample 0 only
curated_dptme_vectors.selection_bias: ordinary, near-threshold and max-amplitude lanes are deliberately mixed

existing_trace_sufficiency.decision: existing data is sufficient for a proof-mechanism and weak-negative directed screen, but insufficient for a representative exact skip or cycle claim

effective dense W, bias, center and threshold or their exact integer codes/scales/widths/zero points
rounding, saturation, overflow and issue-order contract plus hashes
per-source legal input intervals and suffix-bound metadata/hash/word width

resolved_at_k histogram k=0..T by outcome and unresolved-at-T count
issued terms, provably skipped suffix terms and mismatch/interval-violation counts
tile-wide-all-resolved rank, per-output-row all-resolved rank and unresolved-mask occupancy

bound metadata bytes/config cycles and compare/bound-update operation counts

bounded_witness_reservoir.payload: x codes, P/L/U at each k, final h/outcome and exact identity

identity_seal: payload manifest and post-transfer SHA256 verification
minimal_a800_streaming_hook.storage_note: aggregate histograms and bounded witness reservoirs should be reduced on the A800; dumping every full-resolution temporal tensor is unnecessary

fixed_compute_reference.meaning: even a perfect dense T10 ATLIF removal cannot be a multi-x fixed-compute result

dense_rank3_interaction.dense_g12: bounds apply directly to the T_by_T dot product and can skip unissued dense source-time MACs
dense_rank3_interaction.rank3_forward: latent = right*x, then h = bias + left*latent
dense_rank3_interaction.conflict: a dense-input early-stop proof does not automatically survive factorization; stopping only in stage 2 cannot recover stage-1 MACs already spent
dense_rank3_interaction.required_choice: either keep G12 as a dense-engine feature, derive conservative two-stage latent bounds including quantization, or prove that rank3 stage-2-only savings remain material
dense_rank3_interaction.paper_rule: do not add dense G12 savings on top of M265 rank3 cycles without an executable coexisting model

amdahl_and_coexistence.nonattention_assessment: G12 can plausibly become a secondary exact energy optimization, but current evidence cannot make it a main nonattention speed axis; the available denominator supports a low-single-digit system-context uplift unless representative compaction is much stronger than the curated screen

cstep_distinction.cstep_class: network/classification-level temporal early exit or timestep skipping
cstep_distinction.cstep_effect: terminates future network timesteps based on output confidence/stability and may change accuracy, so it normally needs calibration or training
cstep_distinction.g12_class: intra-operator exact branch-and-bound resolution of one PSN temporal dot-product output category
cstep_distinction.g12_effect: stops only the unissued source-time suffix for a proven lane/output and preserves the quantized reference category
cstep_distinction.optical_flow_relevance: there is no classification confidence head to transplant directly; G12 must not be marketed as a classification temporal early exit

cpu_directed_mechanism.elapsed_class: completed in M360 on local curated vectors
cpu_directed_mechanism.outcome: zero integer mismatches, 8.8521 percent ideal term skip for the best tested legal static order, zero tile-wide cycle skip

cpu_additional_work.scope: package the exact analyzer, test range-contract sensitivity and establish the A800 payload parser; do not perform broad issue-order search on sample-0 curated data

a800_s10_capture.budget: 8 to 18 hours implementation and smoke test plus 2 to 6 hours capture/postprocess
a800_s10_capture.why: it is the only path to a representative exact skip distribution and can be streamed without training

rtl.conditional_budget_after_promotion: 12 to 24 hours for a minimal lane-mask/bound-update proof core; full Synopsys closure is not guaranteed inside 48 hours
rtl.reason: current directed evidence has zero tile-cycle saving, no admitted S10 range contract and no settled dense-versus-rank3 coexistence
